method: Read-only inventory, source code/history inspection and prior contact-sheet inspection. No UE operations or asset changes.
recommendation_basis: Four existing pack attack variants not used by the previous SwordCombat selection. Heavy names suggest an emphasis worth checking, not proof of visual quality. Compare originals on source mannequin before judging new-rig retarget.

modifications: pelvis and both leg chains replaced with standing pose
root horizontal displacement multiplied by 0.04 and clamped to 6 cm
upper body blended to standing pose for 0.18 s entry and 0.30 s exit
